title: Table of Notice and Reporting Periods, Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy
content:
Every period in this table for the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy is a count of calendar days.

| Period | 1M | 2M | 3M | 4M | 5M | 10M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Replacement period: days after an underlying policy lapses within which replacement underlying insurance must be scheduled | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 |
| Days between a notice of cancellation for underlying not maintained and the scheduled cancellation date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days past an installment due date after which a nonpayment notice is issued | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Days between a nonpayment notice and the scheduled cancellation date | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Minimum advance notice of nonrenewal before expiration | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days after a nonpayment cancellation within which reinstatement may be requested | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 30 |
| Exposure reporting period: days after acquiring a vehicle, rental unit or watercraft or adding a youthful driver within which it must be reported | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 |

## Where the tiers differ

Larkspur Umbrella 10M differs from the other five tiers on three periods: its replacement period is 45 days rather than 30, its reinstatement request window is 30 days rather than 15, and its exposure reporting period is 45 days rather than 30. The two cancellation notice periods, the nonpayment notice trigger and the nonrenewal notice are the same on all six tiers.

## Terms used in the table

- **Underlying policy lapse.** A scheduled underlying policy that has ended, by cancellation or expiry, while the exposure it insured remains.
- **Scheduled cancellation date.** The date a notice of cancellation names as the date the umbrella is to be cancelled.
- **Nonrenewal notice.** Advance notice that the umbrella will not be renewed; the figure is the fewest days before expiration that the notice may be sent.
- **Reinstatement window.** The figure is the number of days after a cancellation for nonpayment within which reinstatement may be requested.
